text: Materials physics and chemistry is an interdisciplinary field that integrates materials science, physics, and chemistry. It focuses on the "structure - properties - preparation process" as its core research chain, exploring the physical and chemical characteristics of materials at the microscopic (atomic and molecular), mesoscopic (nano and micro) and macroscopic scales. It also aims to achieve functional design and application of materials by controlling their structures. This discipline serves as a bridge connecting basic science and engineering applications, providing key material support for fields such as new energy, information technology, aerospace, and biomedicine.
